narrative: 一张脸并不是剪切到另一张脸，而是顶点在移动。
鼻子、下颌、轮廓线经过一系列“不合法”的中间状态。在若干可测量的秒数内，身份是不稳定的，随后一个新的形态变得实在。
当故事本身就是变形时使用它：一个液态金属人、一张即是解剖结构的面具、一个人变成另一个人。观众应当亲眼看着这个变化发生，而不是通过一次叠化去推断它。
如果两张图像只是应当交替占主导（叠化）、共存（双重曝光），或者跨越一次剪辑产生呼应（匹配剪辑），这就用错了工具。如果你依然能看到两张完整的脸像鬼影一样叠在一起，你做的是叠化。
如果剪辑是生硬的，只有轮廓匹配，你做的是图形匹配剪辑。
how: 建立对应关系：眼睛对眼睛，轮廓对轮廓。进行插值运算，通常在变形之上再叠加一层材质的交叉叠化。
时长本身也是语法的一部分（六秒钟的“变化”就是一句话）。提示词：[Subject] morphs into a named second form over N seconds, continuous transformation, not a dissolve, not a cut。
when: 一张脸在大约六秒钟内变成另一张脸，五官持续移动，最终定格为一个身份。不要把两张完整的肖像做交叉淡化，然后称之为变形。
vs: 叠化（Dissolve）改变的是从镜头A到镜头B的不透明度，形态之间不需要对应关系。
双重曝光（Double Exposure）让两张图像同时存在；匹配剪辑（Match Cut）在相似形状处接合两个镜头，而不进行中间过程的插值。
同屏分身（Duplication）把一个人的两个实体版本放进同一个空间；渐变变形（Morph）则把一个变成另一个。
examples_film: 《终结者2》（Terminator 2）在铬合金和人体几何形态之间进行插值运算；《变相怪杰》（The Mask）把人体解剖结构当作变形目标。
《威洛：磨镜传奇》（Willow, 1988）和迈克尔·杰克逊的《黑与白》（Black or White）是早期的数字变形语法范例：对应关系加上时间。
mistakes: 错误的近亲：叠化、双重曝光，或匹配剪辑。破绽：两个鬼影叠加、在相似形状上的生硬剪辑，或者一次没有形变的材质淡化。
解决办法：要求对应的特征持续移动，展示“不合法”的中间状态，最终落定为一个实在的形态。

faq.q: 电影中的匹配变形是什么？
faq.a: 从一张图像或一具身体到另一个的连续几何变换。特征彼此对应并进行插值。这既不是淡化，也不是叠加。

faq.q: 匹配变形 vs 叠化
faq.a: 叠化关乎不透明度；匹配变形关乎形状。在叠化中你能看到两张完整的画面；在匹配变形中你看到的是一张解剖结构正在持续移动的画面。

faq.q: 什么时候应该使用匹配变形？
faq.a: 当身份或物质处于不稳定状态、这个变化过程必须被观众看见时使用它。不要把它当作两个不相关场景之间一次花哨的叠化。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写匹配变形的提示词？
faq.a: 说明起始形态、结束形态和持续时长。要求连续变换、特征持续移动。禁止叠化和双重曝光。

narrative: A face does not cut to another face. Vertices travel.
The nose, the jaw, the silhouette pass through illegal in-between states. Identity is unstable for a measured number of seconds, then a new form is solid.
Use it when the story is transformation: a liquid metal man, a mask that is anatomy, a person becoming another person. The audience should watch the change, not infer it across a dissolve.

It is the wrong tool when two images should merely trade dominance (dissolve), coexist (double exposure), or rhyme across a cut (match cut). If you still see both complete faces as ghosts, you dissolved.
If the cut is hard and only the outline matches, you graphic-matched.
how: Establish correspondence: eyes to eyes, contour to contour. Interpolate, often with a cross-dissolve of textures on top of the warp.
Duration is part of the grammar (a six-second become is a sentence). Prompt: [Subject] morphs into a named second form over N seconds, continuous transformation, not a dissolve, not a cut.
when: A face becomes another face over about six seconds, features traveling, one identity at the end. Do not crossfade two full portraits and call it a morph.
vs: Dissolve changes opacity from shot A to shot B. Forms do not have to correspond.
Double Exposure holds both images. Match Cut joins two shots at a similar shape without interpolating the in-between.
Duplication places two solid versions of one person in a space. Morph turns one into the other.
examples_film: Terminator 2 interpolates the T-1000 through chrome and human geometry. The Mask treats anatomy as a morph target.
Willow (1988) and Michael Jackson's Black or White are early digital morph grammar: correspondence plus time.
mistakes: Wrong cousin: dissolve, double exposure, or match cut. Tell: two ghosts, a hard cut on similar shapes, or a texture fade with no warp.
Fix: require corresponding features to travel, show illegal in-betweens, land on one solid form.

faq.q: What is a morph in film?
faq.a: A continuous geometric transformation from one image or body into another. Features correspond and interpolate. It is not a fade and not a stack.
A dissolve is opacity. A morph is shape. In a dissolve you can see two complete pictures. In a morph you see one picture whose anatomy is traveling.

faq.q: When should I use a morph?
faq.a: When identity or matter is unstable and the change must be watched. Do not use it as a fancy dissolve between unrelated scenes.

faq.q: How do I prompt a morph for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name the start form, the end form, and the duration. Demand continuous transformation with traveling features. Ban dissolve and double exposure.
